instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full-body shot. In an indoor boxing gym with white brick walls and blue floor mats, the man in the gray t-shirt and black shorts (R1) stands on the left, bending forward to help the woman in the blue jacket and dark shorts (R2) sit up. The woman (R2) sits on the blue mat on the right, holding his hands and looking up. Pink boxing gloves lie on the floor in front of them. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene with natural tones.
